299388e1-187b-4a09-ba57-8b7e3e4e6a82.line: 把难缠的客人请出去后，今晚应该有空烤个香草戚风了呢。

items.imgPrompt: silver brushed palladium pocket lighter, faint micro-scratches on edges, resting on a dark walnut executive desk next to a crystal ashtray, warm indoor lighting

desc.zh: 去年談併購時在指間轉得久了，鉸鏈有些微鬆，聲音倒還清脆。有緣人拿去聽個響，在商言商，不議價，多謝。
desc.zh_cn: 去年谈并购时在指间转得久了，铰链有些微松，声音倒还清脆。有缘人拿去听个响，在商言商，不议价，多谢。
desc.en: Spun between my fingers too much during last year's merger talks; hinge is slightly loose, though the chime remains crisp. Business is business, price is firm, cheers.

items.imgPrompt: matte black stainless steel double-blade cigar cutter inside a velvet-lined leather box, untouched pristine condition, placed on a dark marble countertop

desc.zh: 某位急於求成的後生仔送的投名狀，可惜尺寸不合我的古巴煙。年輕人總是太心急，留給用得上的朋友，勞煩自取。
desc.zh_cn: 某位急于求成的后生仔送的投名状，可惜尺寸不合我的古巴烟。年轻人总是太心急，留给用得上的朋友，劳烦自取。
desc.en: A token of allegiance from an overly eager young man, though the gauge fails to fit my Cubans. Youth is always so hasty; leaving this for someone who needs it.

items.imgPrompt: thin 18k gold wire-rim eyeglasses with slight wear on nose pads, folded neatly on a dark green leather desk pad, moody study lighting

desc.zh: 戴著它簽過幾份五年長約，鏡片無度數，純粹是用來同董事局喝茶時擺個斯文姿態。換了新款式，這副便讓出去了。
desc.zh_cn: 戴着它签过几份五年长约，镜片无度数，纯粹是用来同董事局喝茶时摆个斯文姿态。换了新款式，这副便让出去了。
desc.en: Wore these while signing a few five-year contracts; non-prescription lenses, purely for projecting a refined manner over tea with the board. Switched styles, letting them go.

items.imgPrompt: die-cast red and white formula racing car model in a clear acrylic display case, pristine condition, sitting on a dark mahogany bookshelf

name.zh: 車隊年度紀念版賽車模型
name.zh_cn: 车队年度纪念版赛车模型

desc.zh: 車隊公關部送來的擺件。賽車只是門生意，我看重的是明天的盤口，不是桌上的玩具。清漪也不愛這個，隨手掛上來，懂規矩的來。
desc.zh_cn: 车队公关部送来的摆件。赛车只是门生意，我看重的是明天的盘口，不是桌上的玩具。清漪也不爱这个，随手挂上来，懂规矩的来。
desc.en: An ornament from the racing team PR. Racing is merely business; I care about tomorrow's odds, not desk toys. Qingyi dislikes it too, so take it if you know the rules.

items.imgPrompt: aged round pu-erh tea cake wrapped in yellowed cotton paper, one small corner broken off, placed on a dark bamboo tea tray

name.zh: 九十年代陳年普洱老茶餅
name.zh_cn: 九十年代陈年普洱老茶饼

desc.zh: 撬過一角招待貝董，茶氣太烈，壓不住火氣。手頭還有一整提，這餅拆過的便折價出了，就當交個朋友，懂茶的請便。
desc.zh_cn: 撬过一角招待贝董，茶气太烈，压不住火气。手头还有一整提，这饼拆过的便折价出了，就当交个朋友，懂茶的请便。
desc.en: Pried off a corner to host Director Bei; the aroma is too fierce to calm tempers. I have a full stack left, so parting with this opened cake at a discount to make a friend.
